protocol.origin: first control input simulation timestamp of each episode
protocol.timestamp_source: sensor header simulation stamps, never receipt/wall time
protocol.alignment: linear sensor interpolation, then calculate slip; offline/noncausal
protocol.quadrature: trapezoid of mean left/right squared ratios, clipped at window boundaries
protocol.distance: GT xy distance on the same valid segments as slip
protocol.missing: unavailable/null, never zero or success-only filtering
protocol.native: unchanged control-step arithmetic mean of squared ratios; separate namespace

windows.whole_route: first control input to final action end; excludes postarrival stop
windows.post_contact_to_clearance: first recorded cable contact +0.05s to saved x>=3.40m clearance
windows.phases: paired governor command windows relative to own contact; diagnostic only
